use default

union Step(across: int, down: int, name: string) is
    NORTH(..)
    EAST(..)
    SOUTH(..)
    WEST(..)
si

let north = Step.NORTH(0, -1, "N")
let east = Step.EAST(1, 0, "E")
let south = Step.SOUTH(0, 1, "S")
let west = Step.WEST(-1, 0, "W")

let grid =
    [".....",
     ".....",
     "..##.",
     "..##.",
     "...#.",
     "....."]

filled(column: int, row: int) -> bool =>
    row >= 0 /\ row < grid.count /\
    column >= 0 /\ column < grid[row].length /\
    grid[row][column] == '#'

corner(column: int, row: int) -> int =>
    (if filled(column - 1, row - 1) then 1 else 0 fi) +
    (if filled(column, row - 1) then 2 else 0 fi) +
    (if filled(column - 1, row) then 4 else 0 fi) +
    (if filled(column, row) then 8 else 0 fi)

heading(value: int, previous: Step?) -> Step =>
    case value
    when 1, 5, 13 then north
    when 2, 3, 7 then east
    when 4, 12, 14 then west
    when 8, 10, 11 then south
    when 6 then
        if let facing = previous /\ isa Step.NORTH(facing) then
            west
        else
            east
        fi
    when 9 then
        if let facing = previous /\ isa Step.EAST(facing) then
            north
        else
            south
        fi
    else
        throw System.Exception("{value} is not a perimeter corner")
    esac

let inked =
    (0..grid.count)
        |> flat_map(row =>
            (0..grid[row].length)
                |> map(column => (column = column, row = row)))
        |> filter(cell => filled(cell.column, cell.row))
        |> collect_list()

assert inked.count > 0 else "the grid has no filled cell"

let start = inked[0]

let path = LIST[Step]()

let column mut = start.column
let row mut = start.row
let previous: Step? mut = null

do
    let facing = heading(corner(column, row), previous)

    path.add(facing)

    column = column + facing.across
    row = row + facing.down
    previous = facing

    if column == start.column /\ row == start.row then
        break
    fi
od

for line in grid do
    write_line(line)
od

write_line("")
write_line("corner ({start.column}, {start.row})")
write_line("path {path |> map(step => step.name) |> join(" ")}")
